why: This describes Boston Public Schools' district-specific early-learning implementation strategy and its reported outcomes rather than a reusable instructional element or a named adoptable product.
The Best Practice Framework is a preliminary, named framework for reviewing and establishing one clinical competency-education system, not a general explanatory theory of learning.
name: Best Practice Framework for reviewing and establishing clinical competency education
product_description: A five-step framework developed by Han Sang Yun et al. for reviewing and building traditional medicine clinical competency-education systems through governance, graduate competencies, resources, assessment, and curriculum-gap analysis.
